description: Fetch a VPN client configuration for one server on a VPN order. Needs the order_id and its short lookup/magic code (both returned by purchase_vpn), a protocol (wireguard, openvpn or vless) and a server_id from list_vpn_plans. Returns the config file text, ready to import into any standard client. No wallet key needed - the order code is the credential. Call it again for another server or protocol; there is no limit.

code.description: The order lookup / magic code: 8 letters and digits, often written with a dash after the fourth.

protocol.description: wireguard, openvpn or vless. WireGuard servers also serve OpenVPN; VLESS servers only serve VLESS.

name: get_vpn_config
